passage.title: Signals on the Library Wall
passage.deck: Why one library made its building data visible.

sections.heading: A display with a purpose
paragraphs: A city library installed a simple display beside its entrance. It showed how much electricity the building used each hour, allowing visitors to compare a busy afternoon with a quiet morning.
The librarians did not present the figures as a competition. Instead, school groups used the display to ask why demand changed and which activities required the most energy.

questions.prompt: What could visitors compare on the display?
questions.explanation: The first paragraph says visitors could compare electricity use during busy and quiet periods.
